notes.title: METAL BEANS Error 8055 Content Update and MORE!
notes.notes:
[h1]🔋Overview⚡[/h1]
Hello virus defense force! It's been a little bit but after a break we're coming out with a new update! We have updates to events, difficulty options, and an amazing artbook! We've also updated the infinite mode and late game with a new boss to shake things up so be prepared to fight and defend!
[previewyoutube=RDmjqsPOHsU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]🔋New content⚡[/h1]
A New Boss has been added into the game! A new type of virus has been invading the PC and by consuming the other viruses around it, it becomes stronger!

We've also added Mysterious Effects! After beating an event, one of the two open events will have a new symbol above it. The pop-up has become unstable and will cause the world-level to increase temporarily by 1! You will earn twice the amount of bits and score on completion. Due to the instability you will also gain a random chaotic effect. There's a lot in there so please hop in!
[list]
[*] Added Boss to infinite mode as a new challenge for the player
[list]
[*] The longer the boss is alive, the faster it goes
[*] Boss will charge up shockwaves you will have to jump over and avoid
[*] Boss health scales with the amount of enemies used to summon it
[*] The boss can’t be stunned and isn’t affected by knockback, but will temporarily slow down after being hit
[*] The boss also cannot be insta-killed by anything, but insta-kill effects can help players deal good damage
[*] Has a high chance to give large rewards for beating it!
[/list]
[*] Mysterious Effects! After beating an event, one of the two open events will now have a symbol above it representing a Mysterious Effect. This unstable situation will make the event harder with a temporary world-level increase (by 1), but will reward you twice the bits and score than normal on complete! There will also be a random mysterious effect that changes the game in a variety of chaotic ways (but maybe some of them are actually beneficial…?). We will let you find out what’s hiding behind the chaotic data sections, so hop in and explore!
[*] Difficulty selection from main menu (easy/medium/hard) with score scaling based on what you pick
[*] A new option in the pause menu to make the game windowed as a temporary fix for ultra wide users
[*] Fall damage. You can no longer cheese infinite by just dashing off repeatedly
[*] Similarly, you can no longer stand on shops so you can’t cheat certain modes
[*] One shot protection: the player can no longer go from 100% health to 0% from one damage instance
[/list]

[h1]🔋Art Book Release⚡[/h1]
An artbook for METAL BEANS has been made by our wonderful artist! The PDF will have some fun facts and insights about how the art of METAL BEANS was created and how it was shaped through development!

To access the artbook just go to your installation folder on Steam! You can do this by right-clicking METAL BEANS in your Steam Library, going to Manage, then Browse Local Files. The artbook PDF will be located there!
[list]
[*] Free Digital Artbook PDF containing concept art, screenshots, and fun facts about the game 
[/list]

[h1]🔋Balancing⚡[/h1]
Looking through feedback and playtesting we found that people initially stick with Robitz. As the game progressed players started leaning towards Catbot to take on larger hordes of enemies as her basic attack pierced enemies. 

We made the following changes to Robitz to adjust her to a more single-target focused character to help pick off big threats (like our new infinite boss!)
[list]
[*] Robitz's basic attack deals more damage
[*] Catbot's basic attack will now deal less damage for each enemy hit.
[/list]
This still keeps Catbot useful against large hordes of enemies but allows you to use Robitz for more strategies late game!

We've also made a couple of more changes for the general health of the game!
[list]
[*] Made certain perks that had negative effects slightly cheaper
[*] Lowered immunity time gained by immunity perks less
[*] Increased the insta kill floppy slightly more expensive as certain combos were making it just a better version of the kill all floppy
[*] Shortened tutorial
[*] Made enemy health increase slightly less
[*] Increased Robitz punch damage by 16%
[*] Catbot basic attack disks now deal less damage for each enemy they hit
[list]
[*] After the first enemy hit, each subsequent enemy hit with the same disk will be dealt less damage
[*] The first will deal 100% damage, then decreases by 10% at a max of 50% reduction
[*] It will go 100%, then 90%, 80%, 70%, 60%, 50% 
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]🔋Bug Fixes⚡[/h3]
General Bugfixes have been made to help improve the health of the game
[list]
[*] Fixed jumping in and out of enemies leaving you temporarily immune to damage
[*] Fixed meta perk that starts shop perks at a higher level was increasing the level of the cost rather than the perk itself, effectively making it just a bad upgrade, woops. This has been fixed
[*] Fixed dead areas in infinite mode where enemies couldn’t reach the player
[*] Fixed health UI not updating right away after buying health upgrades from shop
[*] Fixed a bug when players enter first-time unlock floppy vending machine tutorial dialogues and end the game then they will never have the floppy vending machine in infinite mode.
[*] Fixed Ranged enemy projectiles incorrectly scaling as the game progresses
[*] Fixed Gacha displaying incorrect images
[*] Fixed health not updating properly when switching from tutorial to tutorial desktop
[*] Fixed death protection in tutorials not updating health bar correctly
[*] Fixed a bug with the emergency swap perk
[*] Fixed some shop item descriptions
[/list]

notes.title: 🔋Bug Fixes and Balancing Changes!⚡
notes.notes:
[b]Fixes
[/b]
- Fixed UI in pause menu so you don't have to be so accurate with your clicks
- Fixed floppies not letting you buy them after buying them out and restocking
- Fixed floppy inventory display being grayed out (woops, not sure how I missed that)
- Hopefully fixed weird teleporter bug where sometimes it would instantly teleport you back

[b]Balancing based on feedback received (and please reach out with more!)
[/b]
- Rebalanced enemy spawn rates in infinite and survival mode (more of a cap on max enemies per group)
- Increased Robitz knockback with their basic punch by 50% as we noticed people tend to find Catbot stronger
- Rebalanced turret mode scaling to make the shockwave (made the shockwave deal less bonus damage each complete cycle, so instead of roughly 5x more damage after 4 world increases, it deals roughly 3x more damage) and enemy capture rate less drastic (similarly, the enemies capture rate after 4 world cycles went from roughly 5x bonus increase to 2.5x bonus increase) of a change
- Infinite mode now gives more currency each difficulty increase to match more closely with other game modes (10 currency each event to now 35 currency each event)

notes.title: METAL BEANS IS OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]METAL BEANS is out right now and ready to play![/b] 

METAL BEANS is a 3D Action-Arcade game where you control two desktop buddies in a computer space. Protect the PC from digital threats by charging up your way through virus creatures and upgrading Catbot and Robitz in the system!

Welcome to METAL BEANS! A 3D Action Arcade game set inside your computer. Play as Robitz and Catbot as you fight through waves of viruses trying to crash your PC!

Our team has been hard at work over the last couple of months developing METAL BEANS adding in new modes and refining the combat.

If you'd like more information, look no further than the METAL BEANS Overview Trailer!

We'll have more updates in the future so please stay tuned!
